question: Group master courses by department. For each group, state the name of the department, the master course code, the number of subjects, the total new shelf price of associated TIP materials, and the number of unique TIP materials. Display the department and master course only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals for each department and a grand total across all departments. All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_subject_offered" AS SELECT "tip_subject_offered_key" AS "tip_subject_offered_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "master_course_number" AS "master_course_number", "offer_dept_name" AS "offer_dept_name", "subject_id" AS "subject_id" FROM beaver."tip_subject_offered";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT "tip_subject_offered_key" AS "tip_subject_offered_key", "tip_material_key" AS "tip_material_key", "subject_id" AS "subject_id" FROM beaver."tip_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_material" AS SELECT "tip_material_key" AS "tip_material_key", "new_shelf_price" AS "new_shelf_price" FROM beaver."tip_material";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    tso.offer_dept_name AS department,
    tso.master_course_number AS master_course,
    tso.subject_id,
    td.tip_material_key,
    tm.new_shelf_price
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.tip_subject_offered_key = tso.tip_subject_offered_key
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.tip_material_key = td.tip_material_key
),
by_dept_course AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    master_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS num_unique_materials,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price,0)),0) AS total_new_shelf_price
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY department, master_course
),
by_dept AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    NULL AS master_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT master_course) AS num_subjects, -- will override below; placeholder
    SUM(num_unique_materials) AS num_unique_materials, -- placeholder aggregation
    SUM(total_new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price
  FROM by_dept_course
  GROUP BY department
),
by_dept_correct AS (
  -- Recompute department-level num_subjects as distinct subjects across all courses in department
  SELECT 
    j.department,
    NULL AS master_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.subject_id) AS num_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.tip_material_key) AS num_unique_materials,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(j.new_shelf_price,0)),0) AS total_new_shelf_price
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.department
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT 
    'Grand Total' AS department,
    NULL AS master_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS num_unique_materials,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price,0)),0) AS total_new_shelf_price
  FROM joined
),
formatted_union AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    master_course,
    num_subjects,
    num_unique_materials,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    1 AS sort_dept,
    1 AS sort_course
  FROM by_dept_course
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    department,
    master_course,
    num_subjects,
    num_unique_materials,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    2 AS sort_dept,
    2 AS sort_course
  FROM by_dept_correct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    department,
    master_course,
    num_subjects,
    num_unique_materials,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    3 AS sort_dept,
    3 AS sort_course
  FROM grand_total
),
with_display AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    CASE WHEN sort_course = 1 THEN master_course ELSE NULL END AS master_course,
    num_subjects,
    num_unique_materials,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    sort_dept,
    sort_course
  FROM formatted_union
)
SELECT 
  department,
  master_course,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(num_subjects AS DOUBLE)) AS num_subjects,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(num_unique_materials AS DOUBLE)) AS num_unique_tip_materials,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(total_new_shelf_price AS DOUBLE)) AS total_new_shelf_price
FROM with_display
ORDER BY department NULLS LAST, sort_dept, master_course NULLS LAST;

  FROM by_dept_course bdc
  JOIN first_dept fd ON bdc.department = fd.department
  UNION ALL
  -- subtotal row for first department
  SELECT bd.department,
         'Subtotal' AS master_course,
         2 AS level_order,
         bd.num_subjects,
         bd.num_unique_materials,
         bd.total_new_shelf_price
  FROM by_dept bd
  JOIN first_dept fd ON bd.department = fd.department
  UNION ALL
  -- remaining departments' detail rows
  SELECT bdc.department,
         CAST(bdc.master_course AS VARCHAR) AS master_course,
         3 AS level_order,
         bdc.num_subjects,
         bdc.num_unique_materials,
         bdc.total_new_shelf_price
  FROM by_dept_course bdc
  WHERE bdc.department NOT IN (SELECT department FROM first_dept)
  UNION ALL
  -- remaining departments' subtotals
  SELECT bd.department,
         'Subtotal' AS master_course,
         4 AS level_order,
         bd.num_subjects,
         bd.num_unique_materials,
         bd.total_new_shelf_price
  FROM by_dept bd
  WHERE bd.department NOT IN (SELECT department FROM first_dept)
  UNION ALL
  -- grand total at the end
  SELECT 'Grand Total' AS department,
         'Total' AS master_course,
         5 AS level_order,
         COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
         COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS num_unique_materials,
         COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price,0)),0) AS total_new_shelf_price
  FROM joined
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT * FROM stacked ORDER BY department, level_order, master_course
),
with_suppression AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(department) OVER (ORDER BY department, level_order, master_course) = department
           AND department NOT IN ('Grand Total') THEN NULL
      ELSE department END AS department,
    -- Keep labels 'Subtotal' and 'Total' visible; otherwise suppress repeats within department
    CASE 
      WHEN master_course IN ('Subtotal','Total') THEN master_course
      WHEN LAG(department) OVER (ORDER BY department, level_order, master_course) = department
           AND LAG(master_course) OVER (ORDER BY department, level_order, master_course) = master_course THEN NULL
      ELSE master_course END AS master_course,
    num_subjects,
    num_unique_materials,
    total_new_shelf_price
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT 
  department,
  master_course,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(num_subjects AS DOUBLE)) AS num_subjects,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(num_unique_materials AS DOUBLE)) AS num_unique_tip_materials,
  printf('%,.0f', CAST(total_new_shelf_price AS DOUBLE)) AS total_new_shelf_price
FROM with_suppression
'''
